grounding.from: Live it Up's dietitian (a competing brand, about 57 days old) called it one of the most expensive all-in-one supplements on the market

value.answer: Mostly overrated, I'd say. It's well made, third-party tested, and most people find it tastes decent. But several of its blends are underdosed, there's no independent clinical evidence for its benefit claims, and at about $112 a box one-time (around $89 on subscription) it's one of the pricier all-in-ones out there. It can make sense if it replaces a few other supplements for you, but I wouldn't expect much beyond that.
